title: Proofread
description: Paste or type some text, then correct its mistakes or rephrase it. The text keeps its language and meaning.

editor.label: Text to correct
editor.placeholder: Paste or type text to correct

review.label: Corrected text
review.editHint: Type or click to edit the text
review.noMistakesPartial: No mistakes in the corrected part
review.kept: Some parts were left unchanged: the model's answer did not look like a correction.
review.keptRephrase: Some parts were left unchanged: the model's answer did not look like a rewrite of the text.
review.partial: The rest of the text was left as it was.
review.stopped: Stopped: the rest of the text was left as it was.
review.fromSelection: Text selected in another app, then corrected.

saved.note: Your text was set aside to show the corrected selection.
